input.free_text_description: This system is an user management platform that serves User, Customer roles. The platform provides capabilities for global exception handler, i accounts, accounts. Secondary concerns include e-commerce functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to search and filter records, so that I can quickly find relevant information.
As a User, I want to upload and manage files, so that I can store and retrieve documents when needed.
As a User, I want to interact with accounts functionality, so that I can accomplish my accounts-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with cards functionality, so that I can accomplish my cards-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with customer functionality, so that I can accomplish my customer-related tasks.
